title: Nutritious Creamy Irish Ice Cream Cake
description: A rich and creamy Irish-inspired dessert featuring a long-fermentation dough crust, banana leaf-wrapped ice cream, and a hint of whiskey. This vegan-friendly cake is perfect for adventurous eaters looking for a unique dessert experience.
instructions: Combine yeast, flour, sugar, cocoa powder, and salt in a large mixing bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and shape dough into a circle, about 1 inch thick.
Bake dough for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, combine coconut cream, maple syrup, whiskey, and vanilla extract in a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour coconut cream mixture into a 9-inch springform pan and freeze for at least 2 hours, or until firm.
Remove ice cream from freezer and top with chocolate chips, walnuts, and pecans. Wrap banana leaves around the outside of the pan and secure with kitchen twine.
Place cake in the freezer for at least 2 hours, or until firm and set.
Remove cake from freezer and slice into 8-10 servings.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional chocolate chips and nuts if desired.
